message: You're so busy virtue-signaling that you're completely missing the point. Newsflash: nobody cares about your pseudo-intellectual take on human dignity. You're not even arguing in good faith – you're just projecting your own anxieties about losing control onto the pro-choice side. And by the way, it's not about forcing women into motherhood, it's about forcing women to carry a fetus to term against their will. That's a huge difference. You're just trying to muddy the waters with your straw man arguments and your faux-feminist posturing. Meanwhile, I'm just here to tell it like it is: you're on the side of oppressive patriarchal structures, and you're too cowardly to admit it.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'cowardly' and accuses them of being 'on the side of oppressive patriarchal structures' without engaging with their argument.  Also uses 'pseudo-intellectual' and 'faux-feminist' as direct attacks.
